Start a timer for one minute and observe for one minute carefully and think the script in your mind.Once the time is over, close the image and speak for about 2 to 3 minutes abut the image.If possible, record your speech and once your speech is over, listen your recordings.Try to make changes and think ways , how you can do better.You also can upload your recordings on youtube or spotify, and share the link in the comment box, so that I also can here your answer.Follow this method for the rest of the lectures.Upload your answer on Spotify and share your answer link in the comment box below. This image depicts a commercial airplane that has overshot a runway and come to rest on a steep, rocky embankment just above the water. The plane is painted with the word "Pegasus" on the side, and "pegasus.com" on the broken-off section of the fuselage, indicating the airline. The aircraft appears to be a Boeing 737, judging by its size and shape. It has suffered significant damage: the fuselage is fractured near the tail section, the front landing gear is not visible, possibly collapsed or buried in the earth, and the tail section is resting at a higher angle compared to the front of the plane. There are no visible flames or smoke, suggesting that this is a post-accident scene and emergency response may have already occurred. Boats can be seen in the water, which may be part of a rescue or investigation operation. The weather is overcast, and the ocean appears relatively calm. This situation suggests a serious aviation incident, but there are no indications in the image of the condition of those who were on board when the incident occurred.
